economy.summary: Her campaign site proposes raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage from $7.25 to $8.75 in 2027, $12 in 2028, and $15 in 2029, and says she will support initiatives to reduce childcare costs and increase childcare tax credits. She also supports continued funding of the PHARE housing affordability fund to address housing costs.
economy.short: Proposes phased $15 minimum wage; supports childcare and housing affordability.

taxes.summary: Her campaign site says she has a plan to allow local communities to change their tax structure as a way to mitigate high housing costs, and says she supports increasing childcare tax credits.
taxes.short: Proposes letting communities change tax structure; increase childcare credits.

abortion.summary: Says a woman's reproductive healthcare decisions need to remain between her and her healthcare provider and no one else, and that she will support initiatives that strengthen access to reproductive healthcare and protect reproductive rights.
abortion.short: Says reproductive decisions belong to woman and provider; protect rights.

healthcare.summary: Says she will work to ensure Medicaid expansion for all and will support initiatives that strengthen access to healthcare, reduce costs, and increase access especially in rural areas, citing York County residents who dropped coverage after federal subsidies expired.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicaid expansion, lower costs, rural healthcare access.

energy.summary: Says she is dedicated to protecting the environment by supporting legislation, funding preservation of natural resources including water quality, and fighting environmental injustices that target vulnerable communities; cites loss of pollinators and trees in York County.
energy.short: Supports environmental legislation, natural-resource preservation, water quality funding.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform opposes deficit spending and supports across-the-board tax cuts for individuals and businesses, as well as eliminating Pennsylvania's inheritance tax.
taxes.short: Opposes deficit spending; supports tax cuts, ending inheritance tax.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform says he is committed to protecting the sanctity of life, born and unborn, while calling for compassion toward women facing unwanted pregnancies.
abortion.short: Says he protects the sanctity of life, born and unborn.

education.summary: His campaign platform supports school choice, saying it is not a threat but an opportunity for all schooling options to compete, and calls for maximizing local control while minimizing state and federal influence in education.
education.short: Supports school choice and local control of education.

guns.summary: His campaign record page says he has opposed gun control measures he viewed as infringing on constituents' constitutional rights; his platform emphasizes Second Amendment protections and an originalist reading of the U.S. and Pennsylvania constitutions.
guns.short: Opposes gun control measures; emphasizes Second Amendment protections.
